MECHANISM: PlayerCmd.GainEnergy (PlayerCmd.cs) computes `finalAmount = Hook.ModifyEnergyGain(...)`, awaits Hook.AfterModifyingEnergyGain over the modifiers, and grants only `if (finalAmount > 0)`. The sim HAS that chain -- EnergyCmd.gain (cmds.py) calls hooks.modify_energy_gain(player, amount) before adding, and relic/art_of_war uses it -- but booming_conch.py:34 does `player.energy += self.ENERGY` and skips it.
